title: A producer follows similar sounds to a better kick

steps.caption: Open the "BD" pad's sample slot: the library shows kicks
Press similar sounds on a kick: its closest matches
Turn off matching on genre: the matches update
Press similar sounds on a match: a trail shows both kicks, in order
Choose the first kick in the trail: its matches come back
Go back: the list of kicks you started from returns
Select a match and press Insert: the slot names it
Reload: the pad still holds it
